caption: The drawing depicts a single long-sleeved garment, possibly a dress or robe, rendered in black ink on a white background. The garment is oriented vertically, with the fitted top section and sleeves widening gradually into a flared lower section that reaches to the bottom of the image. The collar is short and stands up around the neck, with vertical rectangular panels of detailed, linear patterns extending down from the shoulders to the upper chest area, and continuing down the front of the garment to the hem in several parallel bands. Similar patterned bands are visible at the cuffs of each sleeve. The bottom of the garment features two undulating, scalloped rows suggesting layered fabric or ruffles, each bordered with fine decorative lines. In the upper left and right corners of the drawing, there are two rectangular inset illustrations: the left one contains a dense repeat pattern composed of dots and curved lines, while the right one contains a single paisley or teardrop-shaped motif with internal swirls and dot details. The entire composition is executed in fine, monochrome line work, with no color besides the black ink on the white paper.
title: Nightgown
